hero.lede: Golden Sunline Trade designs, supplies, and installs solar-and-battery systems across the Kurdistan Region and Iraq — so your home or business keeps running when the national grid and the neighbourhood generator don't.

why.heading: Built for Iraq's grid — and its sun.
why.sub: Few places on earth suit solar better, or need it more.

cards.title: End the outages
cards.body: The national grid runs only a few hours a day in much of Iraq. Solar and batteries keep your lights, fridge, and internet on around the clock.

cards.title: Cut the generator bill
cards.body: Neighbourhood generator subscriptions and diesel eat into every month's budget. Solar shrinks that bill — or ends it for good.

cards.title: Sun when you need it most
cards.body: Peak heat means peak air-conditioning, exactly when the sun is strongest. Your panels produce hardest on the days you use the most.

cards.title: Made for dust and heat
cards.body: We size and mount every system for Iraqi summers — high temperatures, fine dust, and long, bright days.

about.heading: An Erbil company, powering all of Iraq.
about.body1: Golden Sunline Trade began by importing tier-1 solar hardware into the Kurdistan Region, and grew into a full-service installer. Today we design, supply, and fit complete solar-and-battery systems — then stay on to keep them producing.
about.body2: From a single home in Erbil to factories and farms across Iraq, we build systems tuned to the local grid, the local sun, and your bill — because here, every kilowatt-hour you make yourself is one you don't buy twice.

services.heading: Everything between the sun and your socket.
services.sub: One partner for the whole job — importing the hardware, engineering the system, installing it, and keeping it at full output.

items.title: Home solar & backup
items.body: Rooftop solar with battery backup, sized to keep an Iraqi household running right through the daily cuts.

items.title: Business & industry
items.body: Megawatt-scale rooftop and ground-mount systems that slash generator and grid costs for factories, farms, and offices.

items.title: Batteries & storage
items.body: Store the day's surplus and run all night — seamless backup the moment the grid drops.

items.title: Generator-to-solar hybrid
items.body: Pair solar with your existing generator to cut diesel to a fraction, then phase it out entirely.

items.title: Equipment supply & trade
items.body: Tier-1 panels, inverters, and mounting gear imported and delivered across Iraq at trade prices.

items.title: Service & maintenance
items.body: Cleaning, inspection, and monitoring built for dusty, high-heat sites — protecting your output for decades.

process.heading: From first call to full power in five steps.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.body: We look at your bills, your roof, and your outage hours, then model exactly what solar and storage can do for you.

steps.title: Design & quote
steps.body: Our engineers design the system and hand you a clear, itemised quote in IQD — no surprises.

steps.title: Installation
steps.body: Certified crews mount and wire everything safely — most homes are switched on within a day or two.

steps.title: Switch-on
steps.body: We commission the system and connect your battery backup, and you start running on your own power.

steps.title: Support
steps.body: Monitoring, cleaning, and a local team on call for the entire life of the system.

contact.sub: Tell us about your home or business. We'll come back within two working days with a system design and a price in IQD — no obligation.
